falseFriends.station: Use 'darbo vieta' for workstation, not 'stotis' (train/bus station)
falseFriends.idle: Use 'tuščioji eiga' for machine idle, not 'tingus' (lazy — pejorative)
falseFriends.order: Use 'gamybos užsakymas' for production order, not 'tvarka' (tidiness)
falseFriends.stop: Use 'sustojimas' for production stop, not 'stotelė' (bus stop)
falseFriends.billion: Use 'milijardas' (10^9), not 'bilijonas' (which means 10^12 in Lithuanian long scale)

grammarNotes.caseSystem: 7 cases with complex endings. Nominative for labels: 'prieinamumas'; genitive: 'prieinamumo lygis'. Wrong case endings immediately obvious to native speakers.
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Two genders (m -as/-is/-us; f -a/-ė). Adjectives agree: 'idealus ciklo laikas' (m), 'techninė priežiūra' (f).
grammarNotes.genitiveChains: Genitive chains for compound terms: 'greičio praradimo priežastis' (speed loss reason). Primary driver of Lithuanian's high 3.5x expansion multiplier.
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: comma (,). Thousands: non-breaking space. Percentage: '85 %' (space before %). Lithuanian follows EU formatting.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In genitive chain compounds, only the HEAD noun pluralizes. The genitive modifier stays SINGULAR. CORRECT: 'greičio praradimo priežastys' (speed [gen.sg] + loss [gen.sg] + reasons [nom.pl]). WRONG: 'greičio praradimų priežastys' (speed [gen.sg] + losses [gen.pl] + reasons). The modifier 'praradimo' names the category of loss; only 'priežastys' counts items.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE universal. Full Lithuanian: 'bendrasis įrenginių efektyvumas'. Factors: prieinamumas x našumas x kokybė.
industryContext.manufacturingSectors: Electronics (Teltonika — 30M+ devices/year, Continental, Hella), food processing, wood/furniture, metalworking

commonMistakes: Freezing all nouns in nominative — UI phrases must decline correctly across 7 cases
Using 'performansas' instead of 'našumas' for OEE performance
Omitting diacritics (ą, č, ę, ė, į, š, ų, ū, ž) — changes word meaning
Using period as decimal separator (85.5%) instead of comma (85,5 %)

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'greičio nuostolių priežastys' (WRONG — 'nuostolių' is genitive plural) instead of 'greičio nuostolio priežastys' (CORRECT — 'nuostolio' is genitive singular). The modifier names the category; only the head noun takes plural
notes: OEE universal. Formal Jūs (capitalized). 7-case system with genitive chains produces longest translations (3.5x). NOT Slavic — Baltic family. P95 expansion 2.13x.
